solves.reasoning: birthday wish is about (A)fighting cancer / I am (B)honored they asked me / goal is to (C)raise $200,000
will be (A)touched by cancer / teammates are cancer (B)survivors / fill out the (C)attached donation form
I am (A)honored they asked / our team (B)goal / make a (C)donation
③ healed is wrong; original is 'touched by cancer' (영향 받은), healed(치유된)는 투병 맥락과 모순
② embarrassed is wrong; 'I am honored they asked me'가 원문, 당황스럽다는 반대
④ spend is wrong; goal is to 'raise' $200,000 (모금), spend(소비)는 반대 방향
Most of my teammates are cancer ___ → survivors (생존자)
will be ___ by cancer → touched (영향 받은)
goal is to ___ $200,000 → raise (모금하다)
honored (영광스러운) ≈ privileged. delighted보다 '초대받아 영광'의 뉘앙스를 담음
wish (소원/바람) ≈ desire
donation (기부) ≈ contribution (기여/기부)
honored(영광스럽다)의 가장 먼 뜻 = ashamed(부끄럽다). proud/delighted/pleased는 유사 긍정
touched(영향 받은)의 가장 먼 뜻 = unaffected(영향받지 않은). affected/influenced/moved는 동의
(A) be touched by cancer=영향을 받다 / (B) music touched everyone=감동시키다
'money or goods that you give to help' = donation (기부)
I am ___ (honor) → be동사 뒤 수동 과거분사 honored (영광스럽다)
wish is about ___ (fight) cancer → 전치사 about 뒤 동명사 fighting
Most of my teammates are ___ → cancer survivors (암 생존자들)
I'm asking all of you to ___ → make a donation (기부하다)
